change_summary: Material post-dawn sensing-quality improvement with no Jubilee confirmation. The first post-dawn identity at 06:08:16 CDT had four usable views and two low-detectability Point Clear views. The dawn+20 identity at 06:28:44 CDT matches current status, burst and vision across all six cameras with 3/3 frames; all six now have fair-to-good visibility and moderate-to-high detectability. No fish surfacing/gulping, shrimp or crab concentration, shoreline animal accumulation, bird feeding, people, flashlights, clustered searching, collecting behavior or temporal Jubilee signal was resolved in the visible areas. Grand Hotel and Fairhope live players advanced across isolated 20.349- and 20.360-second daylight samples at 06:31 CDT with rolling endpoints and visible flag/water progression. Fairhope required Seek to live and then reported currently playing live. No fish surfacing/gulping, feeding birds, collecting or search behavior was resolved; neither Fairhope beach is visible. NOAA NGOFS2 03Z guidance is unchanged from the 05:18 snapshot: +1 m over 1 hour, +68 m over 3 hours, +182 m over 6 hours and -30 m over 12 hours; MODEL guidance only. The 02:51 CDT NWS forecast remains east winds 5-10 kt with waves 1 ft or less/light chop. No defensibly dated September 9 first-person Jubilee report was found.
